title: Nondeterministic federation fixture: placement_refuses_enrolled fails in Pair::new when the onboarding probe hits a transport error at 0 ms (controlTaskDropped)
outcome: The entrypoint fixture's listener no longer drops a connection on a real-time preface deadline under the scripted clock, and every pre-preface drop (preface timeout or preface read failure) is recorded with its outcome, so a recurrence of the placement_refuses_enrolled Pair::new failure is attributable. Attribution of the original 56c25a34 incident is carried by w-408873de9a32.
acceptance: The cause is narrowed from source and the preserved run: the 0 ms and controlTaskDropped signals are explained, every excluded path is listed with its evidence, and each remaining candidate is named and classified as a fixture race or a product/environment cause, stating which candidate this change fixes.
The defect is fixed where it lives (fixture or product), with a behaviour test that reproduces the ordering deterministically, with no wall-clock thresholds and no retries.

completion.summary: The federation listener's preface-classification deadline now runs on the channel's control clock: real time in production, and the scripted clock in fixtures. Every pre-preface drop (prefaceTimeout or prefaceReadFailed) is logged with its outcome and peer. A deterministic behaviour test covers the deadline (tests::federation_listener_io::federation_preface_deadline_follows_the_scripted_control_clock). The cause of the entrypoint fixture failure is narrowed by elimination to candidates H1a-H6. This change fixes H1a, the real-time preface timeout race under the scripted clock. Attribution of the 56c25a34 incident is carried by w-408873de9a32. Landed as f8560ab1 on master; Windows FULL test-f306a669 PASS; review pair adopted from b6528469; landing evaluation 1679e311 C1 and C2 PASS.
